problem: Production billing click changed pricing data but the yearly billing control never exposed aria-selected=true, causing the canonical production browser gate to fail.
root_cause: The rescue runtime updated aria-pressed only, while the pricing control contract and production browser oracle use aria-selected for the selected tab state.
prevention: Billing controls must synchronize aria-pressed and aria-selected from the same active boolean.
Production pricing proof must verify both selected state and price mutation.
The fix must preserve static NL/EN route switching after billing interaction.
